sources.name: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS)
sources.officialDownloadNotes: Use BLS-provided downloadable tables/files only (e.g., national/state/metropolitan OEWS downloads). Save raw files under shared/data-sources/salary/raw/.
sources.licenseNotes: US government work (public domain), but verify BLS-specific terms for redistribution of derived tables.

sources.name: ONS Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings (ASHE)
sources.officialDownloadNotes: Use ONS-provided downloadable ASHE tables only (typically XLS/XLSX/ZIP). Save raw files under shared/data-sources/salary/raw/.
sources.licenseNotes: ONS content is typically under the Open Government Licence (OGL); confirm for each download.

sources.name: ESCO Occupation Classification
sources.officialDownloadNotes: ESCO is used for title normalisation/mapping only (not a salary source). If used, store raw exports under shared/data-sources/salary/raw/.
sources.licenseNotes: Check ESCO licensing for redistribution of derived mappings.
